description:
Returns a [paginated](#pagination) list of issue type schemes.

Only issue type schemes used in classic projects are returned.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

parameters.description: The index of the first item to return in a page of results (page offset).
parameters.name: startAt

parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.
parameters.name: maxResults

parameters.description: The list of issue type schemes IDs. To include multiple IDs, provide an ampersand-separated list. For example, `id=10000&id=10001`.
parameters.name: id

parameters.description:
[Order](#ordering) the results by a field:

 *  `name` Sorts by issue type scheme name.
 *  `id` Sorts by issue type scheme ID.
parameters.name: orderBy

parameters.description:
Use [expand](#expansion) to include additional information in the response. This parameter accepts a comma-separated list. Expand options include:

 *  `projects` For each issue type schemes, returns information about the projects the issue type scheme is assigned to.
 *  `issueTypes` For each issue type schemes, returns information about the issueTypes the issue type scheme have.
parameters.name: expand

parameters.description: String used to perform a case-insensitive partial match with issue type scheme name.
parameters.name: queryString

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

400.description: Returned if the request is not valid.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

403.description: Returned if the user does not have the required permissions.
